title: Property cost calculators
lead: Estimate transfer duty, conveyancing fees, bond registration costs and repayments before you commit. Rates as at 7 July 2026: SARS transfer duty from 1 April 2026, the LSSA conveyancing fee guideline from 1 July 2026 and Deeds Office fees from 1 April 2026.
note: These are estimates. Ask us for a formal quote and we will confirm the figures for your transaction.
appNote: The same calculators install to your phone and work offline.
disclaimer: The ancillary costs will vary based on location.
Provision needs to be made by the user for advance municipal charges over the property (usually 3 months in advance).

For Sectional Title acquisitions, there are additional charges: provision for advance monthly levy payment should be made by the client as well as additional charges for more than one Unit and/or Exclusive Use Areas being purchased.

All estimated calculations done here are provided for general information purposes only and do not constitute professional advice. We do not warrant the correctness of this information. For more accurate calculations, please contact us.
